---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new topic, interactive demo, or improvement
title: "[idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What

What would you like to see? A new topic, a better visualisation,
a UX upgrade?

## Why

Why does this fit Foldscape? What's the "small rule unfolds into a
universe" angle? Who is it for — laypeople, students, researchers?

## Sketch (optional)

Code, formulas, diagrams, references, links. Anything that helps the
maintainers understand the idea.

## Citations

Papers, books, blog posts, prior art.
